verdict.rationale: Aircall documents a broad Public API that covers many UI actions: starting outbound calls and dialing in Workspace, pausing and resuming recordings, retrieving transcriptions, sentiments, topics and summaries, creating and launching campaigns, and sending SMS via Messages endpoints, with webhooks and OAuth tutorials alongside. However, nothing claims full UI parity. UI features such as IVR menus, business-hours scheduling, queue callback, the shared inbox and AI Assistant or AI Agent configuration have no evidenced API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity claim or complete endpoint coverage, API configuration of IVR, routing and business hours, API control of AI Agents and Assistants, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
